notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped directed-interaction alternate-advance surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies directed delivery through Flush Queue Request, Time Advance Request Available, and Next Message Request Available, including standard time-role servicing, order metadata, retraction boundaries, callback ordering, and lifecycle cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped directed-interaction alternate-advance services with FederateAmbassador directed receive and grant callbacks
